description: Source code implementing context management and path conversion utilities for RBUS, including hash map handling, dynamic table synchronization, and context retrieval functions.

methods.name: ConvertPath
methods.description: Converts a given path by replacing aliases with their actual paths using hash maps.

methods.name: GetParentContext
methods.description: Retrieves the parent context object for a given path by traversing the path hierarchy.

methods.name: GetRowContext
methods.description: Fetches the context associated with a specific row path.

methods.name: SetRowContext
methods.description: Sets the context for a specific row, including optional alias handling.

methods.name: RemoveRowContextByInstNum
methods.description: Removes row context based on table name and instance number.

methods.name: RemoveRowContextByName
methods.description: Removes row context based on the row's name.

methods.name: IsTimeToSyncDynamicTable
methods.description: Determines if enough time has elapsed to synchronize a dynamic table based on its path.

methods.name: GetParamName
methods.description: Extracts the parameter name from a full path.

methods.name: Context_Init
methods.description: Initializes context hash maps if not already initialized.

methods.name: Context_Release
methods.description: Releases and cleans up context hash maps when no longer needed.

methods.name: GetHandlerContext
methods.description: Constructs a HandlerContext object with path conversion and parent context retrieval.
